_comment: QG6 data invariants, run by harness/core/scripts/data_checks.py (nightly and after a data run; the docstring has the details). Each check runs a shell command in the project root that prints a count: the last non-empty line of stdout is a plain number or a one-line JSON object of numbers, compared with one fixed rule. A command that fails, times out or prints nothing is an error, never a pass, and a file without checks is not a pass either. Commands print counts, not rows: the script never shows or stores what a command prints, only the numbers it reads. To start, move an example from _examples into checks and replace its command with a real counter. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_fields: id (required; letters, digits, _ . -), pattern (a failure pattern id such as B4, or a project pattern such as P2), title, cmd (required), expect (required, exactly one rule), key (the field of a JSON output that eq, min, max, range and drop_max read), timeout_s (overrides data_checks.timeout_s of harness.json).
_rules: eq: N; min: N; max: N; range: [lo, hi]; equal: [a, b] (two fields of the JSON output are equal); ratio_max: [num, den, share] (num / den <= share, den 0 is an error); drop_max: share between 0 and 1 (fails when the value falls below the baseline times 1 - share; the baseline is the newest value of the check that passed or that a person accepted, never a failing one, so a sustained drop keeps failing until someone accepts the new level with data_checks.py --accept ID --reason ...; the first run records the baseline).

_examples.title: a masking rule makes at most 2 wrong replacements on the frozen reference set
_examples.cmd: psql -tAc "select count(*) from reference_masks where masked and not expected"

_examples.title: values known to be sensitive never appear in the cleaned output
_examples.cmd: psql -tAc "select count(*) from cleaned_texts c join known_values k on strpos(c.body, k.value) > 0"

_examples.title: every derived item is built from the current source version
_examples.cmd: psql -tAc "select json_build_object('derived', (select min(source_version) from derived_items), 'source', (select max(version) from source_items))"

_examples.title: no missing or zero embedding vectors
_examples.cmd: psql -tAc "select count(*) from embeddings where embedding is null or vector_norm(embedding) = 0"

_examples.title: negative control phrases produce no extracted facts
a code group expands to its control number of codes
the search index never falls more than 20% below its last good size
the last load wrote as many rows as it read
_examples.cmd: psql -tAc "select json_build_object('read', rows_read, 'written', rows_written) from load_runs order by finished_at desc limit 1"

_examples.title: no decoded rows with empty text
_examples.cmd: psql -tAc "select count(*) from decoded_rows where coalesce(length(body), 0) = 0"

_examples.title: service accounts make at most 5% of the requests in the usage statistics
_examples.cmd: psql -tAc "select json_build_object('service', count(*) filter (where is_service), 'all', count(*)) from usage_stats"
